evidence.note: Hand reaches the closed entry-area closet door handle.
Closet door is open, exposing hanging clothes and shoes.
Hand is closing the closet door.
Closet door is fully closed.
Hand reaches the closed microwave handle.
Microwave door has swung open.
Hand pushes the microwave door closed.
Microwave door is fully closed.
Hand pulls the oven handle and the door begins descending.
Oven door is open with the illuminated interior visible.
Hand raises the oven door toward the closed position.
Oven door is fully closed.
Hand reaches toward the dishwasher handle.
Dishwasher door is open and racks are visible.
Hand raises the dishwasher door.
Dishwasher door is fully closed.
Hand grasps the right-side leaf of the upper cabinet above the sink.
One cabinet leaf has swung outward.
Both leaves of the cabinet remain open.
A hand is pressing a cabinet leaf toward the cabinet face.
Both cabinet leaves are closed.

events.object_description: Upper cabinet above sink, right-hand door leaf

evidence.note: The second cabinet leaf is not yet clearly distinguishable as open.
Camera is repositioned close to the cabinet while the second leaf appears to be moving.
Both cabinet door leaves are clearly open.
Both leaves remain open immediately before closing begins.
One leaf is already closed or nearly closed while the other is being handled.

events.object_description: Upper cabinet above sink, left-hand door leaf

evidence.note: Hand pulls the shallow lower-cabinet drawer beside the refrigerator.
Drawer is open with boxes and a cloth visible inside.
Drawer remains extended immediately before closure.
Drawer is fully closed.

events.object_description: Shallow kitchen drawer immediately left of refrigerator

evidence.note: Hand pulls the upper refrigerator door handle.
Refrigerator door is open and the illuminated fresh-food compartment is visible.
Hand pushes the refrigerator door shut.
Upper refrigerator door is fully closed.
Hand pulls the lower freezer-door handle.
Lower freezer door is open and freezer drawers are visible.
Hand pushes the lower freezer door toward the refrigerator.
Lower freezer door is fully closed.
Living-area laundry closet door is closed.
Door has opened, revealing the stacked washer and dryer.
Laundry closet remains open immediately before closure.
Hand pulls the laundry closet door shut.
Laundry closet door is fully closed.

notes: Open/extended is treated as the on state and closed/retracted as off. Ten distinct movable-part episodes are visible. The two leaves of the upper cabinet were counted separately as required; their individual transition ordering is less certain because both movements occur rapidly and the camera is very close.
scene_description: A first-person traversal of a studio apartment, followed by consecutive manipulations of a clothes closet, kitchen appliances and cabinetry, refrigerator compartments, and a laundry closet.
